cropping: Existing 500-sample (2 s at 250 Hz) grid-localized windows; no raw re-cut; see 2026-10-15 grid report.
channels: Four channels, stored order; development acquisition table has channel_map 0,1,2,3 throughout. Metadata validation only; no new physical inspection.
filters: Third-order zero-phase Butterworth 0.5-12 Hz; temporal demeaning; lags 0,5,...,30; 28x28 covariance; tangent features.
duplicates: No duplicate (part,wear,recording,position_in_recording) identities; W02 archive has no marked duplicate field.
overwrite_protection: Output and log verified absent; runner uses mkdir(exist_ok=False); retain failures and choose a new name for retries.
test_access: Development wears only; sealed W07/W10/W12 absent from supplied repository. No C170 input or test accessed.
epochs: Not applicable: covariance/PCA/logistic regression/k-means; no neural training or epoch selection.
adaptation: Global PCA/precision and logistic scaling fit on other wears. Explicit transductive within-recording reference, scaling, clustering and body refinement use held-out unlabeled strokes.
null_scope: Zero model training labels and held-out support labels permuted. Borrowed within-class precision remains fitted on real training labels; null does not remove that information.
